metadata.description: Demo seed dataset with 25 tickets for testing

tickets.title: Production server experiencing high CPU usage
tickets.description: Main production server (SRV-PROD-01) showing 90%+ CPU usage constantly. Database queries are slow, API response times degraded. Customer orders timing out. Need urgent investigation.

comments.content: Checking server logs and performance metrics now.
Found memory leak in caching module. Deploying hotfix.
Hotfix deployed. Monitoring for 24h.
Confirmed stable. Closing ticket.

tickets.title: Laptop keyboard not responding
tickets.description: Dell Latitude laptop keyboard stopped working after Windows update. External USB keyboard works fine. User needs laptop for client presentation tomorrow.

comments.content: Rolled back Windows update. Testing now.

tickets.title: Wi-Fi connection drops frequently in Building A
tickets.description: Multiple employees in Building A reporting intermittent Wi-Fi disconnects. Affecting productivity and video calls. Issue started yesterday morning.

comments.content: Checking access point firmware and signal strength.
Found interference from neighboring building. Changing channel.

tickets.title: Email client crashes on startup
tickets.description: Outlook crashes immediately after launching. Error message: "Cannot start Microsoft Outlook." User tried restarting computer - no change.

tickets.title: VPN connection timeout errors
tickets.description: Remote worker unable to connect to company VPN. Timeout error after authentication. Blocking access to file shares and internal systems.

comments.content: Resetting VPN credentials. Please try again in 10 minutes.
User still having issues. Escalating to network team.

tickets.title: Printer not responding (Floor 2)
tickets.description: HP LaserJet on floor 2 showing offline status. Power cycled - still not working. Multiple users need to print documents urgently.

tickets.title: Database queries running slow on production
tickets.description: Customer reports timing out when loading order history. Database response times >10 seconds. Needs immediate attention to prevent customer complaints.

comments.content: Running database diagnostics and query optimization.
Found missing index on Orders table. Adding index now.
Index added. Performance improved but still monitoring.

tickets.title: Antivirus update failed on multiple computers
tickets.description: Security scan shows 15 computers failed to receive latest antivirus definitions. Update server may be down. Need to ensure all systems protected.

comments.content: Checking update server status and network connectivity.

tickets.title: File server access denied error
tickets.description: User getting 'Access Denied' when trying to open shared drive. Permissions seem correct in Active Directory. Other users can access same folder.

comments.content: User found alternate solution. No longer needed.

tickets.title: Backup job failing - Critical data at risk
tickets.description: Nightly backup job failed for 2 consecutive nights. Database backups not completing. Production data at risk if hardware failure occurs.

tickets.title: Warehouse shipment delayed - customer impact
tickets.description: Customer order #12345 stuck in warehouse for 3 days. Shipment not processed. Customer calling daily for updates. Urgent resolution needed.

comments.content: Found missing paperwork. Processing shipment now.
Shipment completed. Customer notified.

tickets.title: Forklift maintenance required
tickets.description: Forklift #3 making unusual noise and hydraulics responding slowly. Safety concern. Need maintenance check before continued use.

comments.content: Scheduled maintenance technician for tomorrow morning.

tickets.title: Inventory discrepancy in Zone C
tickets.description: Physical count in Zone C shows 50 units missing from system records. Need to investigate and reconcile inventory. May affect customer orders.

comments.content: Starting full recount of Zone C inventory.
Found data entry error from last week. Correcting now.

tickets.title: Loading dock light broken
tickets.description: Main loading dock light not working. Safety hazard during early morning/evening shifts. Workers using flashlights temporarily.

tickets.title: Missing delivery paperwork
tickets.description: Delivery completed but driver didn't return signed POD (Proof of Delivery). Customer disputing delivery. Need to locate paperwork urgently.

comments.content: Contacted driver. POD was misplaced in truck.
Retrieved signed POD. Sending to customer now.
Customer confirmed receipt. Case closed.

tickets.title: Packaging materials shortage
tickets.description: Running low on bubble wrap and cardboard boxes. Current stock will last only 2 more days. Need urgent reorder to avoid shipping delays.

comments.content: Placed rush order with supplier. Expected delivery in 3 days.
Using alternative packaging temporarily to keep operations running.

tickets.title: Delivery truck GPS malfunction
tickets.description: Truck #7 GPS tracker offline for 2 days. Cannot track real-time location. Driver manually calling in updates. System needs repair.

comments.content: GPS vendor scheduled service appointment for next week.

tickets.title: Pallet jack damaged - replacement needed
tickets.description: Electric pallet jack wheels damaged. Cannot lift pallets properly. Warehouse productivity affected. Need replacement or repair urgently.

tickets.title: Office supplies order needed
tickets.description: Running low on printer paper, pens, and sticky notes. Multiple departments requesting supplies. Need bulk order placed this week.

comments.content: Order placed with supplier. Expected delivery in 3 days.

tickets.title: Access card not working at main entrance
tickets.description: Employee access card not opening main entrance door. Badge reader beeps but door doesn't unlock. Other doors work fine with same card.

comments.content: Testing card reader and checking access permissions in system.

tickets.title: Conference room booking system error
tickets.description: Meeting room booking system showing double-bookings for Room 301. Two teams scheduled for same time slot. Need to fix calendar integration.

comments.content: Found sync issue with calendar. Reset booking system.
System working correctly now. Monitoring for 48 hours.

tickets.title: HVAC temperature too cold in office area
tickets.description: Office temperature 16°C - too cold for comfortable work. Multiple employees complaining. Thermostat set to 21°C but not working correctly.

comments.content: Contacted HVAC maintenance company. Technician scheduled for tomorrow.
Technician found faulty sensor. Ordering replacement part.

tickets.title: Parking permit request for new employee
tickets.description: New employee starting Monday needs parking permit. HR requested admin to process permit and assign parking space in company lot.

tickets.title: Employee onboarding checklist incomplete
tickets.description: New hire from 2 weeks ago still missing equipment: laptop, phone, and office supplies. IT and admin need to coordinate to complete onboarding.

comments.content: Coordinating with IT to prepare laptop and phone.
Equipment delivered to employee. Onboarding complete.
Employee confirmed all equipment received and working.

tickets.title: Fire alarm test scheduled - notify all staff
tickets.description: Building-wide fire alarm test scheduled for Thursday 10 AM. Need to notify all employees via email. Test will last 15 minutes with loud alarms.

comments.content: Email notification sent to all staff. Posters placed in common areas.
Fire marshal requested rescheduling. Need new date from facilities.
